# The golden frame spread every theme is generated at (gen.sh THEME).
# One frame per line: STATE TOOL TICK COLS ROWS [MOOD [SCENE]]
# TOOL, MOOD and SCENE take "-" for none; SCENE is tag,tag (mascot_mood.SCENES).
# A theme without moods ignores MOOD and SCENE (its frames are still compared).
# A theme may add frames-THEME.txt with more lines of its own.
